title: La Bota de León, MAJESTIC STORIES
comment: bota-leon (MAJESTIC): taller de botas en León, Guanajuato. Caras comunes, no famosas; los cuatro se distinguen a simple vista.

chars.LETICIA_TADEO: Mexican woman from Guanajuato, bootmaker, 32 years old, light-brown skin, dark curly hair in a low bun, small gold hoop earrings, a black t-shirt, a brown leather work apron, rolled-up jeans, brown boots, her hands empty.
chars.RAMON_ESTRADA: Mexican man from Guanajuato, old shoemaker, 70 years old, bald on top with a white fringe of hair, thick black-rimmed glasses, a white mustache, a grey work shirt, a worn dark leather apron, dark trousers, his hands empty.
chars.OSCAR_RENTERIA: Mexican businessman, 40 years old, tall, light skin, slicked-back dark-blond hair, clean-shaven, a cognac leather jacket over a black t-shirt, a gold watch, dark jeans, brown leather shoes, his hands empty.
chars.RODRIGO_BARCENAS: Elegant Mexican ranch boss from Guanajuato, 68 years old, light-brown skin, silver hair, a thick silver mustache, a cream felt cowboy hat, a grey wool suit with a black bolo tie, black boots, holding dark sunglasses.

locs.LOC_TALLERBOTAS: Traditional boot workshop in León, Guanajuato, in the afternoon: long wooden workbenches with pieces of brown leather, wooden shoe lasts, hammers and awls, an old sewing machine, shelves full of handmade cowboy boots, tanned hides hanging on the wall, an open door to a colonial street, warm light, no readable text, no signs, no logos, no people.
